mathematics.assertion_tested: For exact exponential AQUAL, a C2 force-free point requires rho=0; a smooth positive-density spherical core instead has a finite-action C1,1/2 branch with divergent Hessian and no-slip Ricci scalar, together with the displayed central circular-orbit law.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Exact rational and symbolic real arithmetic with a0>0, G>0, rho0>0, r>0; 80-decimal mpmath only for an independent root check.
mathematics.conventions: g=Phi'(r)>0, C=4*pi*G*rho0/3, t=sqrt(C*r/a0), u=g/a0, v_c^2=r*g, T=2*pi*r/v_c.
inputs: no-slip weak metric Phi=Psi for the Ricci-scalar consequence
non_claims: No global nonexistence theorem for all relativistic MOND actions.
No claim that finite-action weak or distributional solutions are absent.
No global literature-novelty claim for the leading T proportional to r^(1/4) law.

checks: constitutive Jacobian and its rank-zero origin were symbolically derived
Puiseux coefficients were recursively solved with zero coefficient residuals
the fifth-order series converged against independent high-precision roots
a positive-mu(0) mutation removed the rank collapse while violating the exact target
result: PROVED_UNDER_STATED_ASSUMPTIONS; HPI-Delta is DEAD as an exact classical regular-center theory.
residual_risks: A nonzero external field makes the geometric center non-force-free and breaks the isolated spherical expansion, but displaced positive-density critical points are not analyzed.
A non-C2 physical metric or distributional curvature lies outside the classical regularity gate.
Changing the law in an arbitrarily small neighborhood of y=0 evades exact-law inheritance.
The literature search was narrow and cannot certify global novelty.
